name: @hobo/registry

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hobo/cloud build && pnpm --filter @hobo/identity build && tsc -p tsconfig.json

description: HoBo Registry catalog service (docs/plans/0017 F24): wraps the @hobo/cloud registry catalog engine and adds bundle-manifest ingest (registry.BundleImported facts), fail-closed signature/provenance verification over the @hobo/identity issuer surface, and a deterministic in-memory bundle search index.
